exactSourceStatements: Inscribed in 2024 (19.COM) on the Representative List of the Intangible Cultural Heritage of Humanity
Sevdalinka is a form of traditional urban singing that is practised in Bosnia and Herzegovina.
Performed a capella or with the accompaniment of traditional instruments, the main function of sevdalinka is to tell a story.
